name: Kabir Vaidya
player_statement:
A complete player, Kabir Vaidya has made a big mark in cricket. With 40 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 60*, with an average of 7.16 and a quick strike rate of 52.89. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 3 sixes and 35 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 38.2 overs, taking 14 wickets at an economy rate of 8.45. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
